to  establish    in  addition  to  any  unit  or  division

to enter into such contracts as may be necessary for
the exercise of the powers and the achieving of the
objectives of the Office for Reparations;
to request and receive assistance necessary for the
achieving  of  its  objectives,  from  any  State,
governmental, provincial or local authority or agency,
or any officer thereof, or from any other person or
body  of  persons;
to create, manage and maintain a database which will
include all particulars concerning recommendations
made  with  regard  to  reparations  to  be  granted  to
aggrieved persons. Such database shall also include
details of reparations previously granted by any other
State authority or agency;
to  periodically  inform  aggrieved  persons  or
representatives  of  such  aggrieved  persons  of  the
status of the applications made for reparations, and
to respond in a timely manner to queries related to
the progress of such applications;
to  manage  funds  that  will  be  used  to  provide
reparations  to  eligible  aggrieved  persons  through
